findings.text: Reads os.Getenv("ABS_GO_READ_ONLY") directly, re-parsing the env var config.LoadArgs already parses into cfg.ReadOnly; if config ever grows another source the two will disagree — should honor cfg.ReadOnly.

Bootstrap reads BACKUP_PATH and ALLOW_IFRAME via os.Getenv during fresh-init settings injection, bypassing the config package (documented as the only place env is read); mirrors upstream fresh-init envs, a test covers the tokenSecret omission.
verifyRacedExisting retries 300 times at 10ms (~3s blocking, no context) to wait out the O_EXCL create race; benign guard, arbitrary untestable busy-wait deadline.
ReadOnly vs read-write branches duplicate the handler-construction/Close pattern; cosmetic.
